verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents official OpenFeature providers that can be used in an application in place of a LaunchDarkly SDK, which directly supports vendor-neutral flag code. However, the docs say providers exist only for 'several' SDKs, with no language list, feature-parity details, or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: the list of languages and SDKs that have providers, documentation of feature parity versus the native SDKs, and independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API

citations.quote: LaunchDarkly offers official OpenFeature providers for several of our SDKs
You can use these providers in your application in place of a LaunchDarkly SDK.
